name: § 1, point x – 41
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: x)counter China’s expanding political and economic footprint by offering a better alternative to China’s Belt and Road Initiative through the Global Gateway and similar EU initiatives to increase the EU’s presence and engagement with partners in the Global South, particularly African and Latin American countries; strengthen efforts to counter anti-EU narratives in these countries; engage with China to reduce and alleviate the debt burden on developing countries, also by transforming its loans into grants; call attention to China’s growing economic, political and security influence in Latin America and the Caribbean, large-scale infrastructure and port investments, military engagement and technological cooperation with authoritarian regimes such as those in Cuba, Nicaragua and Venezuela; warn that these activities strengthen China’s global strategic reach and increase economic dependencies;
